[P2] Return the validation API change to design review

Rules 2, “Simplify before you add,” and 3, “Write a design note before the code,” are unmet. This introduces a public testing-package exception and changes checkpoint failure behavior, but the description lists no simpler alternatives or reasons for rejecting them and explicitly states that prior design approval was not obtained. These rules apply beyond the core SDK. Please return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, document the alternatives and chosen approach, and obtain maintainer agreement before further implementation.
